equations.mathtext: \Delta_{ji} = -\eta \frac{\partial E}{\partial w_{ji}} = -\frac{\partial E}{\partial Net_j} \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial w_{ji}} = \eta \delta_j \cdot O_i
\text{For Output Layer, Sigmoid Activation } \Rightarrow \delta_j = (t_j-O_j) \cdot O_j(1-O_j) \Rightarrow \Delta_{ji} = \eta (t_j-O_j) \cdot O_j(1-O_j) \cdot O_i
